findingPanel.theDecisionFollowsThisAdvisory: The decision follows this advisory to every branch, so a pull request that adds it does not fail. Say why, for the next review.
findingPanel.notAffectedTheVulnerableCode: Not affected: the vulnerable code is not used

findingsTable.findingsOfTheDefaultBranch: Findings of the default branch, most severe first
findingsTable.sendAScanFromCi: Send a scan from CI to see findings. See

projectsPage.aProjectAppearsWithIts: A project appears with its first scan. Its default branch is the baseline; other branches are compared with it.
projectsPage.sendAScanFromCi: Send a scan from CI. See

projectPage.whatACheckTreatsAs: What a check treats as a failure. Only advisories the default branch does not have, and nobody has decided about, can fail it.
projectPage.itsScansFindingsAndDecisions: Its scans, findings and decisions are deleted. A later scan creates it again, without them.
projectPage.whatEachScanOfThe: What each scan of the default branch reported, of the last 50 scans.
projectPage.nothingHasBeenSentFor: Nothing has been sent for this project.

scanPage.itMayBeOlderThan: It may be older than the retention period.
scanPage.aScanOfTheDefault: A scan of the default branch is the baseline; everything it reports is new the first time.
scanPage.findingsTheDefaultBranchDoes: Findings the default branch does not have.

packagesPage.whereAPackageIsUsed: Where a package is used, on the default branch of every project. A new advisory in a package shows who is affected.
packagesPage.nothingMatchesOrNoScan: Nothing matches, or no scan has listed packages yet.

setupPage.scanYourLockfilesInCi: Scan your lockfiles in CI with osv-scanner, Trivy or Grype and send the result here. The answer says whether the check passes.
setupPage.useAuditIngestTokenSet: Use AUDIT_INGEST_TOKEN, set where audit runs, or an API token with the editor role from API tokens.
setupPage.scansOfTheDefaultBranch: Scans of the default branch are the baseline. Any other branch, or any scan with pullRequest, reports only the advisories the baseline does not have and nobody has decided about.
setupPage.anAdvisoryIsFoundAgain: An advisory is found again by ecosystem, package, version and advisory id, so a pull request that updates a package clears its old advisories, and one that adds a vulnerable version fails.
setupPage.severityIsTheCvssV3: Severity is the CVSS v3 score when the report has one, then the database's label, then medium.
setupPage.notAffectedFalsePositiveAnd: Not affected, false positive and accepted risk (with an end date) follow the advisory to every branch.
setupPage.packagesShowsWhereEachPackage: Packages shows where each package is used, from the default branch of every project. osv-scanner lists the packages that have advisories unless asked for all of them.

welcomePage.findingsShowHereAsSoon: Findings show here as soon as the first scan of a default branch arrives.

settingsPage.askAnAdminOfThis: Ask an admin of this audit for access.
